messages:
Claire (AE): Hi team — AcmeCorp POC kickoff tomorrow. They asked for SOC2 artifacts, ISO network diagram, and a signed pen-test letter before we hand off staging creds. Who owns the pen-test signatory?
Devon (SE): I can assemble the artifact list. quick Q: do they need raw logs or redacted reports?
Claire (AE): They want evidence for vendor due diligence — full SOC2 Type II report PDF + control description. logs can be redacted but we should confirm.
Ravi (Security Eng): We provide a SOC2 bridge letter + control narratives. We don't share raw access logs. For pen-test letter we have a standard template that says Redwood performed or commissioned a pen-test and lists scope. Signing is legal, but security can pre-sign the attestation before legal review if needed.
Marta (Solutions): Timeline? Acme wants staging creds in 48h if possible. That seems tight for legal.
Devon (SE): Technical blocker: if they want dedicated VPC + IP allowlist, we need a week for networking and steamline pricing. Hosted POC we can do faster but limited to shared infra.
Claire (AE): They asked about cost delta for Dedicated POC vs Hosted. Can PM/Finance confirm ballpark impact (burst vs reserved)? @ops-bot any quick calc?
ops-bot: Estimated delta: Dedicated baseline +20% over hosted for 2-week reserved pool. Burst pricing might add variable costs. See https://redwood.example/pricing-dedicated (internal).
Ravi (Security Eng): Also: KMS separation question from their security team. We can provide attestation that customer keys are isolated in Dedicated; for Hosted we can provide transit encryption and key management controls but not customer-managed keys.
Marta (Solutions): For pen-test letter signatory: propose flow — Security drafts, Legal signs, AE sends to customer. Is that ok?
Ravi (Security Eng): Agreed. I'll drop the pen-test template in this thread in a sec. It lists scope, date, and redacted findings summary.
Devon (SE): Staging creds: prefer presigned SFTP upload for artifacts and a short-lived staging API key. Need contact for their infra team to open IPs: point to person?
Claire (AE): They've given a contact: j.santos@acmecorp.com. I'll ask for their CIDR and desired test windows.
Marta (Solutions): Action items: 1) Ravi: post pen-test template and SOC2 artifact list. 2) Devon: estimate infra lead time for Dedicated vs Hosted. 3) Legal: prepare sign-off (Claire will ping). Claire: confirm "no raw logs" policy with customer.
Claire (AE): Got it — I'll ping Legal and confirm logs with Acme. Trying to keep staging creds to 48-72h window.
Ravi (Security Eng): Posting template now:\n```
Pen-test Attestation Template
- Customer: <customer>
- Scope: production/staging subnets + auth flows
- Date: <date>
- Summary: Redwood engaged third-party firm; findings remediated or accepted; redacted report available upon NDA
- Signatory: Legal (name)\n```
Marta (Solutions): That looks good. One more: Acme asked whether we can provide network diagram with pop-out of VPC peering shapes. I'll attach our standard ISO diagram after this.
Devon (SE): FYI: If they request on-prem validation, that's a separate quote.
Claire (AE): Thanks all — I'll update Acme with plan and timeline, ping Legal for signatory. If anything urgent, DM me. :thumbsup:
